diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_config_configuration_aggregator.organization references :resource.aws_iam_role.config_organization via organization_aggregation_source.role_arn, but registering the organization as an aggregation source requires the AWSConfigRoleForOrganizations policy to already be attached to that role. Terraform will not wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.config_organization, so the aggregator creation can fail. A depends_on on the policy attachment is required.

module.vpc_baseline_ap-northeast-1:resource.aws_flow_log.default_vpc_flow_logs delivers flow logs to the audit log S3 bucket (log_destination = local.s3_destination_arn), but has no dependency on :resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.audit_log, whose AWSLogDeliveryAclCheck/AWSLogDeliveryWrite statements grant delivery.logs.amazonaws.com access. If the flow log is created before the bucket policy is applied, log delivery silently fails.
